children: This week's Crop Progress report from the USDA says U.S. corn crops have begun to be harvested — with 5% of the crop harvested as of the week of Sept 6. That's one point higher than this time last year. The report does not show soybean harvesting as having started. Crop conditions for both corn and soybeans are steady, with corn in good-or-excellent condition down one point to 56%, while soybeans stay unchanged at 58% good-or-excellent. Harvesting usually begins around this time for U.S. corn, with soybean harvesting tending to start in October. CBOT grain futures are lower in pre-market trade, with most-active corn down 0.7%, soybeans down 0.2%, and wheat down 0.1%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
